```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from datetime import date

# Create a new Document
doc = Document()

# Add header "MEMORANDUM" centered
header = doc.add_heading('MEMORANDUM', 0)
header.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Add recipient info
doc.add_paragraph()  # Add a blank line

recipient.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

para1.add_run("Dear Team,\n\n")
run1 = para1.add_run("We are pleased to announce new remote work guidelines that will help balance work flexibility with our core operational needs. These policies are designed to support our employees while ensuring business continuity.")
run1.bold = True

para2 = doc.add_paragraph()
para2.add_run("Effective immediately, employees may work remotely up to two days per week, subject to manager approval. All team members must ensure their availability for virtual meetings and maintain regular communication with colleagues.")

para3 = doc.add_paragraph()
para3.add_run("Please note the following key requirements:\n")
bullets = ["Submit your remote work schedule to your manager at least 48 hours in advance.", "Core hours (10 AM - 3 PM) must be available for team collaboration.", "All work must be completed within the standard work week.", "Employees must have a dedicated workspace at home."]
for bullet in bullets:
    p = para3.add_run(bullet + "\n")
    p.add_run(bullet).bullet = True

para4 = doc.add_paragraph()
para4.add_run("We encourage open dialogue about these policies. If you have questions or concerns, please reach out to the HR Department.\n\nThank you for your continued dedication.")

# Save the document
doc.save('/workspace/company_memo.docx')
print("Document saved successfully as company_memo.docx")
EOF
```

```python
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from datetime import date

# Create a new Document
doc = Document()

# Add header "MEMORANDUM" centered
header = doc.add_heading('MEMORANDUM', 0)
header.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Add recipient info
doc.add_paragraph()
recipient = doc.add_paragraph()
recipient.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

# Add the memo fields
for field in ["To: All Staff", "From: HR Department", "Date: " + date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"), "Re: Office Policy Update"]:
    recipient.add_run(field + "\n")

# Add spacing
doc.add_paragraph()
doc.add_paragraph()

# Add title
content = doc.add_heading('Office Policy Update: Remote Work Guidelines', level=1)

doc.add_paragraph()

# First paragraph
para1 = doc.add_paragraph()
para1.add_run("We are pleased to announce new remote work guidelines that will help balance work flexibility with our core operational needs. These policies are designed to support our employees while ensuring business continuity.")
para1.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(12)

# Second paragraph
para2 = doc.add_paragraph()
para2.add_run("Effective immediately, employees may work remotely up to two days per week, subject to manager approval. All team members must ensure their availability for virtual meetings and maintain regular communication with colleagues.")

# Third paragraph with bullets
para3 = doc.add_paragraph()
para3.add_run("Please note the following key requirements:")
para3.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(12)

para4 = doc.add_paragraph()
for bullet in ["Submit your remote work schedule to your manager at least 48 hours in advance.", "Core hours (10 AM - 3 PM) must be available for team collaboration.", "All work must be completed within the standard work week.", "Employees must have a dedicated workspace at home."]:
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.add_run(bullet)
    p.paragraph_format.bullet = True

# Closing paragraph
para5 = doc.add_paragraph()
para5.add_run("We encourage open dialogue about these policies. If you have questions or concerns, please reach out to the HR Department.\n\nThank you for your continued dedication.")

# Save the document
doc.save('/workspace/company_memo.docx')
print("Document saved successfully as company_memo.docx")
```
